capabilities: import handwritten scans as Markdown notes
watch Google Drive or a synced folder (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Syncthing) for new scans
insert scans into today's daily note
edit the import template to change the resulting note layout
disambiguation: Handwriting recognition happens in the Papersync app with your own AI provider; the plugin makes no network requests and only imports the finished Markdown.
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README stresses privacy: no Papersync server, account, or telemetry, and no network requests from the plugin; Google Drive access uses the drive.file scope with the token in Obsidian's secret storage (see SECURITY.md). On macOS, reading an offloaded iCloud file triggers a download. Support is via GitHub Discussions and Issues; MIT licensed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn handwritten paper scans into editable Markdown notes without manual transcription.

requires.name: AI provider API key chosen in the app
Some AI providers charge for use

summary: Companion-app pipeline that imports handwritten phone scans from Google Drive or a synced folder into your vault as Markdown in today's daily note.
